headline: UK House Prices Fall 0.6% in October in Sharpest Drop in a Year
summary: UK house prices declined 0.6% in October, marking the sharpest monthly drop recorded in a year.
why: Residential property price indices reflect consumer housing affordability, mortgage demand, and broader domestic economic confidence.

impacts.name: United Kingdom
impacts.why: Falling property values reflect cooling domestic real estate market activity.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A larger-than-expected drop in property prices signals softening demand within the UK housing market.
